newsitem.title: USA: Station wins new $150 mln financing pact.
newsitem.headline: Station wins new $150 mln financing pact.

text.p: Station Casinos Inc said it has received $150 million to refinance the remaining costs of building its Sunset Station Hotel & Casino in Las Vegas.
The investor group providing the credit is led by BankAmerica Corp, Societe Generale and Bank of Scotland, it said.
"Completing these financings frees up $150 million of the company's revolving bank credit facility for further development projects," Glenn Christenson, chief financial officer said.
He added the company is currently looking at possibly expanding its Station Casino St. Charles, near St. Louis, Missouri.
